title.en: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay San Agustin, Municipality of Sagbayan, Province of Bohol, To Be Known As San Agustin National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay San Agustin, Municipality of Sagbayan, Province of Bohol, To Be Known As San Agustin National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay San Agustin, Thị trấn Sagbayan, Tỉnh Bohol được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia San Agustin
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ San Agustin, เทศบาล Sagbayan, จังหวัด Bohol ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ San Agustin
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay San Agustin, Kotamadya Sagbayan, Provinsi Bohol dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional San Agustin
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay San Agustin, Perbandaran Sagbayan, Wilayah Bohol dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan San Agustin

text.en: There shall be established under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national high school in Barangay San Agustin, Municipality of Sagbayan, Province of Bohol, to be known as San Agustin National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
